policy.shape: Unchanged qualified four-kind single-via-node prohibitory all-state envelope, distinct from/to ways.
policy.scope: No eligible directed from-via-to transition in the COMPLETE fixed source pre-arc profile. Keep represented bans and every independent closure/access/node constraint. Missing-via/unknown/complexity/only-turn forms keep fallback. Profile/source/pre-arcs changes invalidate the certificate. No permission, local-surrogate turn, timing-price or app admission claim.

sourceFacts: A prohibitory relation forbids proceeding along its specified from/via/to geometry. Existing exact-shape all-state classifier stays; conditions remain opaque and ban stays permanent where representable.
inference: If the COMPLETE fixed major-road pre-arc profile has no eligible directed from-via-to transition, this particular no-turn has no represented maneuver to prohibit. Its whole-way fallback need not close unrelated road travel. This is graph-scope reasoning from exact physical port absence, not source permission, provider behavior or a new general claim about absent signs.
requirements: Fresh independent source ID/way eligibility/complete pre-arc port audit and captured native oracle parity before graph/model use. Every represented static ban and independent source closure/direct access/node constraint stays. Profile/input changes invalidate and require recomputation.
exclusions: Only-turns, unknown/mixed/complex conditions, missing-via/nonanchor/complexity fallbacks stay. Local surrogate links remain unverified driving/turn behavior; this rule cannot grant access on them. No speed/cost/flags/place exception or gate change.
